senses.en: Plant tissue that carries sugars from the leaves.

ex.en: Phloem carries food to the roots.
ex.zh: 韧皮部把养分输送到根部。

senses.en: Tiny openings on leaves that let gases in and out.

ex.en: Stomata close in dry weather to save water.
ex.zh: 天气干燥时气孔会关闭以保存水分。

senses.en: A thick underground stem that stores food, such as a potato.

ex.en: Potatoes are tubers, not roots.
ex.zh: 土豆是块茎，不是根。

senses.en: An underground stem that grows sideways and sends up new shoots.

ex.en: Ginger grows from a rhizome.
ex.zh: 姜是从根茎长出来的。

senses.en: News reporting, especially detailed accounts based on direct observation

ex.en: Her vivid reportage brought the remote village to life.
ex.zh: 她生动的报道让那个偏远村庄跃然眼前。

ex.en: Independent reportage can reveal environmental damage that might otherwise escape public attention and government scrutiny.
ex.zh: 独立报道可以揭露那些原本可能逃过公众关注和政府审查的环境破坏。

tip: 通常不可数，比reporting正式，常强调现场记录。

senses.en: An organism that makes its own food, such as a green plant.

ex.en: Plants are autotrophs that use sunlight.
ex.zh: 植物是利用阳光的自养生物。

senses.en: An organism that gets food by eating other organisms.

ex.en: All animals are heterotrophs.
ex.zh: 所有动物都是异养生物。

senses.en: Making food using energy from chemical reactions instead of light.

ex.en: Deep-sea bacteria survive by chemosynthesis.
ex.zh: 深海细菌靠化能合成生存。

senses.en: An organism that breaks down dead plants and animals.

ex.en: Fungi are important decomposers in forests.
ex.zh: 真菌是森林中重要的分解者。

senses.en: Overused and therefore no longer interesting or original

ex.en: The film ends with a trite speech about friendship.
ex.zh: 影片以一段关于友谊的老套演说结束。

ex.en: Public awareness campaigns may fail when they rely on trite slogans rather than practical advice and convincing evidence.
ex.zh: 公众宣传活动如果依赖老套的口号，而非实用建议和有说服力的证据，就可能失败。

tip: 强调因反复使用而失去新意，不只是年代久远。

senses.en: Dead plant and animal material, or waste left after something breaks up.

ex.en: Worms feed on detritus in the soil.
ex.zh: 蚯蚓以土壤中的碎屑为食。

senses.en: Light produced by living things.

ex.en: Many deep-sea fish use bioluminescence.
ex.zh: 许多深海鱼会生物发光。

senses.en: Finding objects by sending out sounds and listening for echoes.

ex.en: Bats hunt insects using echolocation.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠利用回声定位捕捉昆虫。

senses.en: A deep sleep in which some animals spend the winter.

ex.en: Bears lose weight during hibernation.
ex.zh: 熊在冬眠期间体重下降。

senses.en: The everyday language spoken by people in a particular place.

senses.zh: 本地语言的；本土风格的
senses.en: Using local everyday language or traditional local building styles.

ex.en: Our guide chatted with market traders in the local vernacular.
ex.zh: 导游用当地话与市场里的商贩闲聊。

ex.en: Teaching in the vernacular can help young children understand lessons while maintaining connections with their cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 用本地语言教学能帮助幼童理解课程，同时保持与自身文化传统的联系。

col: the local vernacular｜当地日常用语
tip: 强调当地日常语言，不等同于“本国的”。

senses.en: A period of inactivity in which growth stops.

ex.en: Seeds may stay in dormancy for years.
ex.zh: 种子可能休眠多年。

senses.en: Active during the day.

ex.en: Most songbirds are diurnal.
ex.zh: 大多数鸣禽是昼行性的。

senses.en: Behavior by which animals attract a mate.

ex.en: Peacocks display their tails during courtship.
ex.zh: 孔雀在求偶时开屏。

senses.en: Searching for food.

ex.en: Bees spend the day foraging for nectar.
ex.zh: 蜜蜂整天采集花蜜。

senses.en: Living in groups with division of labor and only some members breeding.

ex.en: Ants and honeybees are eusocial insects.
ex.zh: 蚂蚁和蜜蜂是真社会性昆虫。

senses.en: To make someone feel excited, energetic, and very happy

ex.en: The fast boat ride exhilarated everyone on board.
ex.zh: 快艇飞驰让船上的每个人都兴奋不已。

ex.en: Outdoor adventures can exhilarate participants while helping them develop confidence and a stronger connection with nature.
ex.zh: 户外探险能让参与者精神振奋，同时帮助他们增强自信，加深与自然的联系。

col: exhilarated by the experience｜因这次经历而振奋
an exhilarating experience｜令人兴奋的经历
tip: 及物动词；人感到兴奋用exhilarated。

senses.en: A chemical released by an animal that affects others of its species.

ex.en: Ants follow pheromone trails to food.
ex.zh: 蚂蚁沿着信息素踪迹找到食物。

senses.en: The release of eggs by fish or amphibians.

ex.en: Salmon return upstream for spawning.
ex.zh: 鲑鱼洄游到上游产卵。

senses.en: The period during which a baby develops inside its mother.

ex.en: Elephants have a gestation of about 22 months.
ex.zh: 大象的妊娠期约为22个月。

senses.en: A young animal that has just come out of its egg.

ex.en: Turtle hatchlings race to the sea.
ex.zh: 刚孵出的小海龟奔向大海。

senses.en: so small that it is almost impossible to measure
a mathematical quantity smaller in magnitude than any positive real number

ex.en: The scratch made an infinitesimal difference to the table's appearance.
ex.zh: 这道划痕对桌子外观的影响微乎其微。

ex.en: Even infinitesimal changes in ocean temperature can become significant when measured across vast areas over decades.
ex.zh: 即使海水温度变化极其微小，若在广阔海域持续数十年，也可能产生显著影响。

tip: 比small语气强得多；名词用法主要见于数学。

senses.en: A young bird learning to fly; someone or something new and inexperienced.

ex.en: The fledgling left the nest after two weeks.
ex.zh: 雏鸟两周后离开了巢。

senses.en: The joining of male and female cells; adding fertilizer to soil.

ex.en: Fertilization takes place inside the flower.
ex.zh: 受精在花内进行。

senses.en: To carry pollen to a flower so that it can produce seeds.

ex.en: Hummingbirds pollinate many tropical flowers.
ex.zh: 蜂鸟为许多热带花卉传粉。

senses.en: The growth of a plant toward light.

ex.en: Phototropism makes seedlings bend toward a window.
ex.zh: 向光性使幼苗朝窗户弯曲。

senses.en: Relating to the separate parts that make up a whole

ex.en: Our tutor used componential analysis to compare similar words.
ex.zh: 我们的老师用成分分析法比较近义词。

ex.en: In linguistics, componential analysis examines word meanings by breaking them down into smaller, shared semantic features.
ex.zh: 在语言学中，成分分析通过将词义分解为较小的共有语义特征来研究词义。

tip: 专业形容词，常见于语言学术语componential analysis。

senses.en: A plant's growth in response to a stimulus such as light or gravity.

ex.en: Roots show a tropism toward water.
ex.zh: 根表现出向水性。

senses.en: Working out the exact order of units in DNA; arranging things in order.

ex.en: Gene sequencing has become fast and cheap.
ex.zh: 基因测序已变得快速而便宜。

senses.en: Relating to changes in gene activity that do not alter the DNA itself.

ex.en: Diet may cause epigenetic changes.
ex.zh: 饮食可能引起表观遗传变化。

senses.en: The process by which cells become specialized; telling things apart.

ex.en: Stem cell differentiation produces nerves and muscle.
ex.zh: 干细胞分化产生神经和肌肉。

senses.en: thick and sticky, flowing slowly

ex.en: Honey is more viscous than water.
ex.zh: 蜂蜜比水黏稠。

ex.en: Volcanoes with viscous lava tend to erupt explosively because gas cannot escape easily.
ex.zh: 熔岩黏稠的火山往往爆炸式喷发，因为气体不易逸出。

tip: 火山喷发类型话题常见。

senses.en: The natural, programmed death of cells.

ex.en: Apoptosis removes damaged cells.
ex.zh: 细胞凋亡清除受损细胞。

senses.en: The body's ability to keep conditions inside it stable.

ex.en: Sweating helps maintain homeostasis.
ex.zh: 出汗有助于维持体内平衡。

senses.en: Relating to the chemical processes that keep living things alive.

ex.en: Hummingbirds have a very high metabolic rate.
ex.zh: 蜂鸟的代谢率非常高。

senses.en: The movement of water through a membrane toward a stronger solution.

ex.en: Roots absorb water by osmosis.
ex.zh: 根通过渗透吸收水分。

senses.en: The spreading of particles from high to low concentration; the spread of ideas.

ex.en: Oxygen enters the blood by diffusion.
ex.zh: 氧气通过扩散进入血液。

senses.en: previously mentioned in the same document or statement

ex.en: The contract says we must pay the aforesaid fee.
ex.zh: 合同规定我们必须支付上述费用。

ex.en: The aforesaid conditions must be satisfied before the council can approve any construction within the protected area.
ex.zh: 必须满足上述条件，地方议会才能批准保护区内的任何建设项目。

tip: 法律或正式书面语，通常置于名词前。

senses.en: Made of a single cell.

ex.en: Amoebas are unicellular organisms.
ex.zh: 变形虫是单细胞生物。

senses.en: Made of many cells.

ex.en: Multicellular life appeared about 600 million years ago.
ex.zh: 多细胞生命大约在6亿年前出现。

senses.en: A hormone that controls the amount of sugar in the blood.

ex.en: People with diabetes may need insulin injections.
ex.zh: 糖尿病患者可能需要注射胰岛素。

senses.en: An organ near the stomach that produces insulin and digestive juices.

ex.en: The pancreas releases insulin after meals.
ex.zh: 饭后胰腺会分泌胰岛素。

senses.en: Showing disrespect for religion, or using offensive language.
To treat something sacred with serious disrespect.

ex.en: The coach apologised for his profane language after the match.
ex.zh: 教练为赛后说的粗话道了歉。

ex.en: Museums should explain why objects considered ordinary by outsiders may be sacred, making careless treatment seem profane.
ex.zh: 博物馆应解释为何外人眼中的普通物品可能是神圣之物，以致随意对待会显得亵渎。

col: profane a sacred place｜亵渎圣地
tip: 形容词常修饰language；动词指亵渎神圣事物。

senses.en: A scientist who studies how living things relate to their environment.

ex.en: Ecologists counted the birds in the wetland.
ex.zh: 生态学家统计了湿地里的鸟类。

senses.en: The central stone of an arch; something on which others depend.

ex.en: Sea otters are a keystone species in kelp forests.
ex.zh: 海獭是海藻林中的关键物种。

senses.en: Relating to feeding and nutrition in a food chain.

ex.en: Energy is lost at each trophic level.
ex.zh: 每个营养级都会损失能量。

senses.en: The killing and eating of other animals.

ex.en: Predation keeps rabbit numbers in check.
ex.zh: 捕食使兔子的数量得到控制。

senses.en: The larger front bone between the knee and ankle

ex.en: The doctor showed me my tibia on the scan.
ex.zh: 医生在扫描影像上指给我看我的胫骨。

ex.en: A fracture of the tibia may require several months of rehabilitation before an athlete can safely resume training.
ex.zh: 胫骨骨折可能需要数月康复，运动员才能安全恢复训练。

col: the tibia and fibula｜胫骨和腓骨

senses.en: The flesh of dead animals.

ex.en: Vultures feed on carrion.
ex.zh: 秃鹫以腐肉为食。

senses.en: The eating of plants by animals.

ex.en: Some plants produce toxins to resist herbivory.
ex.zh: 有些植物产生毒素来抵御植食动物。

senses.en: Allowing animals to eat so much grass that the land is damaged.

ex.en: Overgrazing turned the grassland into desert.
ex.zh: 过度放牧使草原变成了沙漠。

senses.en: Not originally from the place where it now lives.

ex.en: Non-native plants can crowd out local species.
ex.zh: 外来植物可能排挤本地物种。

senses.en: Expressing very strong feelings, especially anger or opposition

ex.en: Her vehement refusal surprised everyone at the table.
ex.zh: 她激烈的拒绝让桌旁的每个人都很惊讶。

ex.en: The proposed closure of the community library met with vehement opposition from residents and local educators.
ex.zh: 关闭社区图书馆的提议遭到了居民和当地教育工作者的强烈反对。

tip: 多形容反对、否认或批评的强烈程度，语气较正式。

senses.en: A person who works to protect the natural environment.

ex.en: Conservationists campaigned to save the forest.
ex.zh: 自然保护人士发起运动保护这片森林。

senses.en: The breaking of something into small separate parts.

ex.en: Habitat fragmentation isolates animal populations.
ex.zh: 栖息地碎片化使动物种群相互隔离。

senses.en: Planting trees on land where a forest was cut down.

ex.en: Reforestation helps reduce soil erosion.
ex.zh: 重新造林有助于减少水土流失。

senses.en: Planting trees on land that has not recently been forest.

ex.en: Afforestation projects aim to stop the desert spreading.
ex.zh: 植树造林项目旨在阻止沙漠扩张。

senses.en: Unpleasantly loud and harsh in sound.

ex.en: Raucous laughter from the kitchen woke the sleeping cat.
ex.zh: 厨房里传来刺耳的大笑声，吵醒了熟睡的猫。

ex.en: Residents argue that raucous nightlife disrupts sleep and reduces the appeal of otherwise attractive urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 居民认为，喧闹的夜生活扰乱睡眠，也降低了原本宜居的城市街区的吸引力。

tip: 强调声音粗哑刺耳或喧闹，不只是嗓音沙哑。

senses.en: The build-up of salt in soil or water.

ex.en: Poor irrigation can cause salinization of farmland.
ex.zh: 不当灌溉会导致农田盐碱化。

senses.en: The top layer of soil, where most plants grow.

ex.en: Wind blew away the dry topsoil.
ex.zh: 风把干燥的表土吹走了。

senses.en: Water from rain or farms that flows over land into rivers.

ex.en: Fertilizer runoff pollutes the lake.
ex.zh: 化肥径流污染了湖泊。

senses.en: The loss of substances from soil as water passes through it.

ex.en: Heavy rain causes leaching of nutrients.
ex.zh: 大雨导致养分淋失。

senses.en: Too many nutrients in water, causing algae to grow and oxygen to fall.

ex.en: Eutrophication killed the fish in the pond.
ex.zh: 富营养化使池塘里的鱼死亡。

senses.en: A gemstone often showing changing colours when light strikes it

ex.en: The opal in her ring flashed green and blue.
ex.zh: 她戒指上的欧泊闪着绿色和蓝色的光。

ex.en: Opal mining can provide employment in remote regions, although it may also disturb fragile desert environments.
ex.zh: 欧泊开采能为偏远地区提供就业，但也可能破坏脆弱的沙漠环境。

tip: 珠宝语境常称“欧泊”；并非所有蛋白石都有变彩。

senses.en: Relating to algae.

ex.en: An algal bloom turned the water green.
ex.zh: 藻华把水染成了绿色。

senses.en: A lack of oxygen in the body or in water.

ex.en: Hypoxia creates dead zones in the ocean.
ex.zh: 缺氧在海洋中形成死区。

senses.en: The process of becoming more acidic.

ex.en: Ocean acidification harms shellfish.
ex.zh: 海洋酸化危害贝类。

senses.en: Made of tiny separate particles; such particles in the air.

ex.en: Particulate pollution affects city residents' lungs.
ex.zh: 颗粒物污染影响城市居民的肺部。

senses.en: having many different kinds or aspects

ex.en: The market's multifarious offerings included spices, pottery, and handmade toys.
ex.zh: 市场上的商品五花八门，包括香料、陶器和手工玩具。

ex.en: Urban planners must consider the multifarious needs of residents when designing accessible and inclusive public spaces.
ex.zh: 城市规划者设计便利且包容的公共空间时，必须考虑居民多种多样的需求。

tip: 正式词，强调种类多；日常多用varied或diverse。

senses.en: A substance that makes something impure or dirty.

ex.en: Lead is a dangerous contaminant in drinking water.
ex.zh: 铅是饮用水中的危险污染物。

senses.en: How poisonous a substance is.

ex.en: Scientists tested the toxicity of the chemical.
ex.zh: 科学家检测了这种化学品的毒性。

senses.en: A chemical used to kill unwanted plants.

ex.en: Farmers sprayed herbicide on the weeds.
ex.zh: 农民向杂草喷洒除草剂。

senses.en: A chemical used to kill insects.

ex.en: Insecticides may also harm bees.
ex.zh: 杀虫剂也可能伤害蜜蜂。

senses.en: A substance that drives something forward or forces liquid out
Providing the force that moves something forward

ex.en: This spray can uses compressed air as its propellent.
ex.zh: 这个喷雾罐用压缩空气作喷射剂。

ex.en: Developing cleaner rocket propellents could reduce the environmental impact of the growing commercial space industry.
ex.zh: 开发更清洁的火箭推进剂有望减少不断发展的商业航天业对环境的影响。

tip: 是propellant的较少见拼写；写作优先用后者。

senses.en: A chemical used to kill fungi.

ex.en: Grapes are often treated with fungicide.
ex.zh: 葡萄常用杀菌剂处理。

senses.en: A chemical compound containing phosphorus, used in fertilizers.

ex.en: Phosphate from detergents fed the algae.
ex.zh: 洗涤剂中的磷酸盐使藻类大量繁殖。

senses.en: The process of turning a gas into a usable compound; an obsession.

ex.en: Nitrogen fixation by bacteria enriches the soil.
ex.zh: 细菌固氮使土壤更肥沃。

senses.en: Capturing and storing something, such as carbon dioxide.

ex.en: Forests provide carbon sequestration.
ex.zh: 森林能固存碳。

senses.en: relating to farming and land

ex.en: The region was mostly agrarian a century ago.
ex.zh: 一百年前，这个地区主要以农业为主。

ex.en: The shift from a hunting-based to an agrarian economy allowed populations to settle in permanent villages.
ex.zh: 从狩猎经济转向农业经济，使人们得以定居在永久村落中。

tip: 历史类文章常对比 agrarian society 与 industrial society。

senses.en: A gas once used in fridges and sprays that damages the ozone layer.

ex.en: Chlorofluorocarbons were banned to protect the ozone layer.
ex.zh: 为保护臭氧层，氯氟烃被禁止使用。

senses.en: Action to reduce how harmful something is.

ex.en: Climate mitigation focuses on cutting emissions.
ex.zh: 气候减缓措施侧重于减少排放。

senses.en: The loss of color, as when corals lose their algae.

ex.en: Warm water causes coral bleaching.
ex.zh: 温暖的海水导致珊瑚白化。

senses.en: Wet, soft ground made of decaying plants.

ex.en: Peat bogs store huge amounts of carbon.
ex.zh: 泥炭沼泽储存着大量的碳。

senses.en: The layer of shrubs and small trees beneath a forest canopy.

ex.en: Shade-loving plants grow in the understory.
ex.zh: 喜阴植物生长在林下层。

senses.en: Unwilling to do something.

ex.en: I was loath to leave the warm kitchen.
ex.zh: 我舍不得离开温暖的厨房。

ex.en: Many residents are loath to support redevelopment projects that could destroy the character of their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 许多居民不愿支持可能破坏社区特色的重建项目。

col: be loath to admit｜不愿承认
be loath to leave｜不愿离开
be loath to accept｜不愿接受
tip: 常用be loath to do；勿混淆动词loathe（厌恶）。

senses.en: Bushes and plants growing thickly under trees.

ex.en: A deer disappeared into the undergrowth.
ex.zh: 一只鹿消失在灌木丛中。

senses.en: Dark, rich soil made from decayed plants.

ex.en: Humus makes soil hold water better.
ex.zh: 腐殖质使土壤更能保水。

senses.en: Decayed plant matter used to enrich soil; to make it.

ex.en: Kitchen scraps can be turned into compost.
ex.zh: 厨余可以制成堆肥。

senses.en: Turning food and garden waste into compost.

ex.en: Composting reduces the waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 堆肥减少了送往垃圾填埋场的垃圾。

senses.en: Something believed to solve every problem or cure every illness.

ex.en: A new phone is no panacea for your troubles.
ex.zh: 换部新手机并不能解决你所有的烦恼。

ex.en: Although technology can improve classroom learning, it should not be regarded as a panacea for educational inequality.
ex.zh: 虽然技术可以改善课堂学习，但不应被视为解决教育不平等的万全之策。

col: a panacea for｜解决……的万能之策
a universal panacea｜包治百病的灵丹妙药
tip: 常用a panacea for；多用于否定万能解法。

senses.en: Able to be processed and used again.

ex.en: Most glass bottles are recyclable.
ex.zh: 大多数玻璃瓶可以回收。

senses.en: Able to be broken down naturally by bacteria.

ex.en: The cups are made from biodegradable plastic.
ex.zh: 这些杯子由可生物降解塑料制成。

senses.en: Not able to be replaced once used up.

ex.en: Coal is a nonrenewable resource.
ex.zh: 煤是不可再生资源。

senses.en: Fuel made from plants or animal waste.

ex.en: Corn is used to make biofuel.
ex.zh: 玉米被用来制造生物燃料。

senses.en: Lose a pregnancy before the baby can survive outside the womb.
Fail to achieve the intended result.

ex.en: After she miscarried, her family offered comfort and support.
ex.zh: 她流产后，家人给予了安慰和支持。

ex.en: People who miscarry should have access to compassionate medical care and appropriate psychological support.
ex.zh: 流产者应能获得充满关怀的医疗服务和适当的心理支持。

col: miscarry early in pregnancy｜孕早期流产
